title: docs: clarify open quest selection
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Documents that multiple contributors may submit solutions without claiming a quest first.
- States that maintainers select and assign the best completed approach before merge.
- Aligns the quest template, contributor guide, dashboard/FAQ copy, Polli context, and social guidance.

gist.headline: Many hands, one quest
gist.blurb: Quests are now clearer about their natural habitat: several good solutions growing at once. Maintainers pick and assign the strongest completed approach before it merges.
gist.summary: Updated quest templates, contributor guidance, dashboard FAQ copy, Polli context, and social guidance to clarify that multiple contributors can submit solutions without claiming a quest first, after which maintainers select and assign the best completed approach before merge.
gist.impact: Contributors can confidently work on open quests in parallel, while maintainers have a clearly documented process for choosing the solution that earns the fixed Pollen reward.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a warm, observant quest gardener reviewing several healthy code-plants submitted by different contributors, then placing a small ribbon on the strongest bloom. A retro quest board and a few neat solution scrolls make the open-submission and maintainer-selection process visible, with flowers and seeds reinforcing collaborative growth.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art community garden where Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny maintainer clipboard, thoughtfully selects one flourishing code-plant from several contributor-grown pots beneath a retro quest board reading "OPEN QUEST." Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
